subject: physical-education

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain the critical features or key principle of assembling evidence across all activity categories in your own words.
Demonstrate or fully describe self-assessment against stated criteria rather than against others using a version your body and setting allow. A described or adapted version earns full credit.
Apply explaining a tactical or training principle in the learner’s own words in a new situation and explain the decision or adjustment you made.
Analyze a plausible technique fault, tactical error, or unsafe choice involving documenting progress by capability, never by body; correct it and explain why.
Connect choosing Grade 10 activity directions and justifying the choice with reviewing the safety and stop-rule plan against a year of use and explain how one affects the other.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Assemble and present the portfolio to one trusted adult: category evidence, a training principle explained, the revised safety plan, and a justified plan for Grade 10.
Identify one thing you can now do or direct yourself, one adjustment that improved it, and one next goal you set for yourself.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated safe participation and self-management criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill cues or movement quality criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated tactical or training reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated self-assessment and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. An adapted or described performance is full credit, not partial credit.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Grade 9 Capstone: Personal Movement Portfolio?
